need: A neighbour has one free hand and a parcel that takes two. The last ferry sounds its first bell.

routes.action: Carry the parcel
routes.returnLine: I had a hand free to hold my little boy. He wanted to carry the receipt himself.

routes.action: Walk ahead to the landing
routes.returnLine: They held the boat for us. The next family had to run.

need: The keeper promised to cover a friend’s market shift. A second promise falls on the same afternoon.

routes.action: Keep the stall
routes.returnLine: The takings bought our supper. My friend still has my apron.

routes.action: Teach the work call to a stand-in
routes.returnLine: I heard my signal from another pair of hands today. I could finally go home.

need: A stamp would let the apprentice sell before nightfall. The agent has never handled the apprentice’s work.

routes.action: Try the agent’s press
routes.returnLine: The stamp got us into the fair. Tomorrow the buyer wants the trial slip too.

routes.action: Put the apprentice at the public bench
routes.returnLine: She made her own demonstration. The last two customers had already left.

need: A visitor commissions a small case. Their sketch shows where the audience stood, but nobody has measured the wall.

routes.action: Survey the available wall
routes.returnLine: The case fits. We shifted a stool and made room for somebody to turn around.

routes.action: Build a model the visitor can turn
routes.returnLine: The visitor found a better angle. I had to cut one new hinge.

need: The runner has a reason for taking the long way home. A borrowed notice needs to be read at two doors.

routes.action: Learn the route with the runner
routes.returnLine: The second door was open. You can hear a whole extra voice from that step.

routes.action: Make a notice that can travel without the runner
routes.returnLine: Both households were able to lift their own slip. The runner got a morning off.

need: An old keeper wants company on the last walk of a working life. They keep stopping in places no map records.

routes.action: Follow the pauses in the walk
routes.returnLine: We made three stops. One was just to smell the bakery again.

routes.action: Sketch what the keeper sees at each stop
routes.returnLine: My daughter recognised the way from the angle of the last window.

need: Two families recognise the parcel on the lost shelf. Both remember the same tear in the wrapper.

routes.action: Trace the wrapper’s layers
routes.returnLine: The older paper came from our house. The newer repair came from theirs.

routes.action: Set up a hearing at the collection rail
routes.returnLine: They agreed on a place to keep it. The next borrower must ask both families.

need: The room has a warm corner where the night porter eats. The new sign will hide it.

routes.action: Repair the room around the occupied seat
routes.returnLine: My spoon still fits on the sill. Visitors can see what you mended.

routes.action: Find a second pool of light
routes.returnLine: We moved the reading lamp. I share supper with the last reader now.

need: The apprentice has made a piece in the teacher’s style. The teacher wants visitors to recognise the apprentice’s hand.

routes.action: Hang the practice pieces in sequence
routes.returnLine: They saw the join I used to get wrong. One visitor asked me to show it again.

routes.action: Let the apprentice run the live trial
routes.returnLine: My hands shook on the first run. They stayed for the second.

need: A weaver needs a lens. Its lender needs a sailcloth patch. Neither can close their stall to make the exchange.

routes.action: Send a marked crate around the stalls
routes.returnLine: My lens came with the weaver’s seal still tied to it.

routes.action: Hold a trading shift for the three makers
routes.returnLine: We argued out a price ourselves. It cost a whole morning and one good joke.

need: Three households have kept different pieces of a demonstration. None wants to be the only one who gives theirs up.

routes.action: Mount the parts at a shared bench
routes.returnLine: The visitors can turn the hinge. My piece comes home each evening.

routes.action: Make a picture of each part in its own home
routes.returnLine: The village saw the whole arrangement. We kept the originals on our own shelves.

need: A complaint filed years ago has surfaced under a fresh heading. The person who wrote it lives next door to the clerk.

routes.action: Follow the original sheets
routes.returnLine: I can show where my sentence stopped. The clerk has pinned up the later addition.

routes.action: Offer both people a place behind the screen
routes.returnLine: We finally spoke. I still want my complaint on record.

need: At night an empty archive chair casts a person’s shadow across the census rail.

routes.action: Keep watch through the quiet shift
routes.returnLine: I saw which foot touched the board. The person on the day shift slept through it.

routes.action: Rehearse the census lamp from both sides
routes.returnLine: We reproduced the shadow in daylight. Somebody will still have to see what happens tonight.

need: The festival can afford one table. A family wants it for supper and a maker wants to show the village how a tool works.

routes.action: Put supper first and cook both batches
routes.returnLine: We ate together. The maker took a smaller audience after the plates came off.

routes.action: Give the maker an early demonstration
routes.returnLine: Four children stayed to help fold the table and supper had to start late.

need: A pilot can guide you past the edge of the printed chart. A neighbour uses the same place to gather reeds.

routes.action: Walk the boundary with the neighbour
routes.returnLine: We left the reed bed off the racing line. Somebody has to guide visiting boats.

routes.action: Take the pilot’s overlapping views
routes.returnLine: The blank has a shoreline now. The neighbour asked us to leave the landing unnamed.

need: Two estranged friends have written on opposite sides of a sheet. Each wants the other to read first.

routes.action: Carry the sheet with both margins
routes.returnLine: They saw where the paper had worn thin from turning it over.

routes.action: Ask both to make a band from their letters
routes.returnLine: My thread crosses theirs. We still have to decide who keeps the band.

need: A paper-winged creature has missed its usual return to the windowsill. The keeper’s child has left the latch undone.

routes.action: Sit at its old perch
routes.returnLine: It came back when the room emptied. My child has left a second perch outside.

routes.action: Watch the other entrances
routes.returnLine: It has a whole route we never saw. I can shut the latch again.

need: The crew’s old meeting song has two endings. Two relatives are waiting at different doors.

routes.action: Play both endings at the stair
routes.returnLine: I found the door where my sister was singing an answer.

routes.action: Guide the two parties with flags
routes.returnLine: We met halfway. For a minute we forgot which of us was late.

need: A mentor has prepared a trial using the wrong light on purpose. Their apprentice thinks a poor first result will cost them the job.

routes.action: Let the apprentice change the lamp
routes.returnLine: I got to question the equipment in front of the person who bought it.

routes.action: Ask the mentor to calibrate beside them
routes.returnLine: We balanced it together. My mentor told the rest of the shift about the first run.

need: A line on the quay grows sharper every time it is repeated. The first speaker is worried about the last listener.

routes.action: Follow the line through the presses
routes.returnLine: I found the copy that dropped my hesitation. I can mend it at the press.

routes.action: Let the two listeners repeat the line in different places
routes.returnLine: The echo changed a word all by itself. We owe one another a better hearing.

need: An old debt was measured in days of work. The two ledgers count a day from different bells.

routes.action: Count the shared shifts
routes.returnLine: We agree on the mornings. There are still two evenings to settle.

routes.action: Take a day at the stall in payment
routes.returnLine: One shift is settled. The next worker has a clean receipt.

need: The keeper means to apologise. The person waiting by the door would rather work with them than hear a speech.

routes.action: Repair the cracked stand together
routes.returnLine: We have a stand that stays upright. We found time for two sentences while the glue set.

routes.action: Let the waiting person choose the moment
routes.returnLine: They came when the room was quiet. Nobody clapped, which helped.

need: Rain is coming through the high window. The dry corner fits the papers or the late crew’s coats.

routes.action: Move the papers in a balanced crate
routes.returnLine: The papers are dry. We took turns wringing out the coats.

routes.action: Give the crew the dry corner and reroute the lamps
routes.returnLine: People could keep working. There is a tide mark on the lowest folder.

need: The keeper misses the first signal and asks for one more entrance. The audience has already turned away.

routes.action: Give the understudy a different cue
routes.returnLine: It was a quieter entrance. This time I could see the whole back row.

routes.action: Rewind the working music box
routes.returnLine: We found the pin that caught. The next actor will hear it too.

need: A witness can identify the maker’s mark by touch. They will come only if someone stays to mind the stall.

routes.action: Take the witness’s shift
routes.returnLine: I got to put my own hand on the mark. My customers still had a place to go.

routes.action: Take the mark to the witness in a tactile record
routes.returnLine: I could read the cord at my stall. Somebody must keep the original safe for another check.

need: A child has pointed out a mark below the adults’ sightline. The person who made the sign is here.

routes.action: Frame the sign from the child’s height
routes.returnLine: The adults had to kneel to see why I was pointing.

routes.action: Let the sign maker set a new light
routes.returnLine: My little brother saw it without anyone lifting him up.

need: One neighbour measures the common step by wheel. The other counts the paces of a person carrying a basket.

routes.action: Roll the wheel together
routes.returnLine: We can repeat the number. Nobody has settled the question of carrying a full basket.

routes.action: Walk it with the two route charts
routes.returnLine: We chose a different route for the heavy baskets. The measured step is still there.

need: A donor wants their gift in the first glass case. The family that kept it first wants one quiet visit alone.

routes.action: Make a reversible display
routes.returnLine: The family could take the stand apart before the first visitor arrived.

routes.action: Give both accounts room on the wall
routes.returnLine: Visitors ask who kept the gift before the donor had it. The family will choose when to answer.

need: A petition has one mark from each household. A visitor says people signed before they heard the last line.

routes.action: Return the words through the signing queue
routes.returnLine: Two households changed their marks. They were glad to hear the full line.

routes.action: Let each household tie a fresh count
routes.returnLine: We can check the count by hand. The petition missed the early sitting.

need: The last verse belongs to a singer who has lost their voice. The new choir wants to start on time.

routes.action: Arrange the entrance around the singer’s rest
routes.returnLine: I kept my place in the tune even though somebody else sang the note.

routes.action: Let the music box carry the missed bar
routes.returnLine: They played it again after rehearsal. I showed the maker where the note had bent.
